sets.trigger_composition_logic: OR of documented direction branches, each branch ANDs the side predicate with common gates; UNAVAILABLE is not FALSE and blocks that predicate.
sets.direction_semantics: DB-R-BTC-001 generic deterministic BTC direction: RETURN(BTC,5m)>0 -> LONG; <0 -> SHORT; =0 -> ZERO; unavailable -> UNAVAILABLE. BTC floor predicates DE>=0.30, ATR percentile>=15, ATR percentile<=97, TOD_REL_TURNOVER>=0.70 remain actual predicates.

edge_behavior.unavailable: Required UNAVAILABLE is never numeric zero or FALSE and cannot become a match.
edge_behavior.zero: Preserved where explicitly documented, including BTC RETURN(BTC,5m)=0 -> ZERO and inclusive sign-compatibility predicates for R-022/R-026 replacements.
edge_behavior.none: Classifier NONE means no satisfied directional criterion; final unmatched evaluation has direction NONE.
edge_behavior.conflicting_direction: No downstream reinterpretation or reversal of frozen Set direction.
edge_behavior.incomplete_trigger_evaluation: Fail closed / unavailable according to frozen Set semantics; do not synthesize evidence.
